body:
ABSORBED by §58 (T261, merged 2026-09-01, PR #517): binding at consent is S1 (T262); authorship on the read surface is S6 (T267).

The signature is in the bytes: the OAuth exchange mints a per-connector actor seed (SPEC §37) and every delta the connector writes names that author, surviving disconnect and revoke (§39). But no surface a tester actually reaches shows it. From chat, a resolved View is values only and the GraphQL meta fields (_entity/_hex/_hviewHex/_view/_asOf/_forgotten) carry no author, so Claude cannot answer 'who said this'. On /admin, the dashboard is the session user's subtree and the root container's membership is authoredBy(userKey), while a connector's writes are signed by ITS key straight into the primary ground — §39's per-connection inbox exists in the library (Gateway.bindConnection) but nothing in src/server calls it at consent — so the user's page counts none of what Claude filed, and the Connections panel lists no live OAuth connector. Two independent readers confirmed this 2026-09-01 while checking docs/first-steps.md; the doc now says the truth (the store knows; the pages do not yet show it), and this ticket is the promise the doc had to withhold: 'you can always tell your claims from the AI's'.

Two halves, possibly two tickets, both CHANGING WHAT THE SYSTEM PROMISES and therefore Myk's design and merge: (1) wire the consent flow to bindConnection so a connector writes into its own inbox pool under the owner's container (the §39 model as specified — with the migration question for connectors that already wrote into the root ground); (2) expose authorship on the read surface — a `_author` meta field or an authors-of-this-view reading — so an agent can answer who said what, with the masking rules stated (a public reader should not learn private authors). Design questions (Myk): does (2) belong on every view type or only where a reading declares it; is the author a public key or a name the home resolves; does (1) land as a §20 migration for existing connector deltas or leave them where they are and attribute from now on.

Acceptance criteria (draft, to be settled at P1):
- (a) A connector's write through loam_mutate lands in its inbox pool; /admin's Connections panel lists the connector; the attention summary for the owner's container counts it by author. Verify: test/server/connector-inbox.test.ts.
- (b) A view read through loam_query can name its authors under the declared rule, and a masked reader learns nothing it could not already. Verify: test/gateway/view-authors.test.ts.
- (c) Revoke keeps every past delta attributed; disconnect changes nothing written. Verify: the same suites, two-sided.
title: Who said that, from where a person is standing: connector writes visible and attributed on the surfaces they reach
